requiredControls.freeze: Bind an opaque external artifact-and-oracle bundle to an exact pre-tuning Git commit, version, and SHA-256 digest.
requiredControls.access: Keep raw artifacts and labels outside the public repository under a separately administered, least-privilege access policy.
requiredControls.evaluator: Name a qualified evaluator who is independent from implementation tuning and whose conflicts of interest have been reviewed.
requiredControls.leakage: Record every artifact, label, membership, and result exposure; exposed cases cannot silently remain protected evidence.
requiredControls.execution: Pin the public command, product revision, adapter/browser/runtime environment, resource limits, and deterministic output checks.
requiredControls.oracleCorrection: Require a reasoned correction, independent review, new bundle version and digest, and impact analysis before changing frozen truth.
requiredControls.reporting: Publish split-, family-, rule-, and evidence-specific integer numerators and denominators with exclusions, uncertainty, and non-claims.

blockers: No separately controlled external artifact-and-oracle bundle has been frozen.
No qualified evaluator independent from implementation tuning has accepted responsibility.
No access authority or exposure log exists for protected artifacts and labels.
forbiddenClaims: Public repository fixtures are protected holdout data.
A protected-holdout result exists while status is notOperational.
Current public results establish representative real-world Web UI or UX accuracy.
Current public results justify blocking maturity for a recommended Web rule.
